name: emem-signer
description: A local signer for emem memory writes. It holds your Ed25519 signing key, given as a sensitive plugin option, and signs only the writes you compose. Optional: install it beside the emem plugin when you want to write signed notes; reading emem needs no key.

signing_seed_hex.title: Signing key
signing_seed_hex.description: The 32-byte Ed25519 seed that signs your emem memory writes, as 64 hex characters. It is stored in your secure credential store and given only to the local emem-signer process.
